title: Card
summary: A titled panel with optional media, header actions and footer. Vertical or horizontal (stacking by its own width), flush for tables, and optionally one link.

props.name: heading
props.description: The card title. Without it (and without actions) the header is not shown.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level the title exposes to assistive technology (aria-level).

props.name: tone
props.description: error draws the border in the error colour.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Horizontal puts the media beside the content; it stacks when the card is narrower than 30rem (a container query, not the viewport).

props.name: flush
props.description: No padding around the content, for a table or an edge-to-edge body.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole card one link (a single tab stop named by the heading).

props.name: fill
props.description: Fills a flex parent (a workspace pane): the card takes the remaining height, has no padding, and its body is the scroll region.

slots.name: media
slots.description: An image, picture or video at the top (or the start when horizontal).

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons or links at the right of the header.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Content below the body; hidden when empty.

parts.name: media
parts.description: The media wrapper; hidden when empty.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The padded content column (header, body, footer).

parts.name: link
parts.description: The overlay link when href is set.

cssProperties.name: --pk-card-media-width
cssProperties.description: Media width in the horizontal layout.

a11y: The title is exposed as a heading whose level you choose with level, so the card fits the page outline wherever it sits. With href the card holds one link named by the heading, so there is a single tab stop and no nested interactive content.

blazor.notes: Keeps the existing PkCard parameters (Title maps to heading).
